name: 视频号花字 / Channels Sticker-Pop
vibe: Loud, hand-edited Chinese creator short: chunky white+yellow 花字 slammed around the head with hard drop shadows, sticker-cut presenter with a fat white outline on candy backgrounds; quiet clean subtitles in between.

reference.creator: 我李哥豆儿 (视频号)
reference.what: the whole type system: mixed white/yellow heavy display words, hard offset shadow, words placed around the head, giant word cropped at frame edge, cutout with white/light-blue outline, polka-dot / gingham / crumpled paper / magenta backgrounds, dashed circles

reference.creator: 剪辑师白菜 (视频号)
reference.what: the quiet layer: small clean white subtitle with soft shadow at chest height, no box, no outline; mono shrink, doc fly, end title

density: Something on screen in ~60% of the time, but in bursts: a 花字 or sticker beat every 3–6 s on the key phrase, 1.5–4 s each; between them 2–5 s of plain face with only the small subtitle. Never two 花字 shots back to back without a sticker / face beat between.
not: thick black text outlines (tb2_zh) — the outline here is a hard offset shadow, not a stroke
stroked/boxed karaoke captions — subtitles are small, white, soft shadow only
clean corporate minimal (nischa) — this is loud, many colours in the backgrounds, but text uses only white + yellow (+ one orange/blue accent line)
